question: Where is café located within 70 kilometers in the forward direction toward Willamette University, Portland, OR from Troll Bridge, Portland, OR?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry::geography AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Troll Bridge%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Portland%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OR%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_point AS ( SELECT geometry::geography AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Willamette University%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Portland%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OR%' LIMIT 1 ), azimuth_info AS ( SELECT s.geom AS start_geom, d.geom AS dest_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geom, d.geom)) AS target_azimuth FROM start_point s, destination_point d ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, azimuth_info ai WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ai.start_geom, 70000) -- Within 70 kilometers (70,000 meters) AND ( -- Calculate the azimuth from the start point to the current cafe -- and check if it's within +/- 22.5 degrees (a 45-degree cone) of the target azimuth. -- LEAST handles angle wrap-around (e.g., 350 degrees vs 10 degrees). LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ai.start_geom, p.geometry::geography)) - ai.target_azimuth), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ai.start_geom, p.geometry::geography)) - ai.target_azimuth) ) <= 22.5 );

answers.addr_street: Northeast Martin Luther King Junior Boulevard
